author: alice.morgan
title: Welcome to the Community Forums!
body: Hello everyone! This is the place to connect, share ideas, and get help from fellow Liferay developers. Feel free to introduce yourself and tell us what you're working on!

author: bob.chen
title: REST API returns 403 after upgrading to 2025.Q4
body: I just upgraded our dev environment to 2025.Q4 and now all my custom REST endpoints are returning a 403 Forbidden. I haven't changed any Service Access Policies. Is there a new security configuration I missed?

author: carla.rivera
title: How to configure SSO with SAML 2.0 and Azure AD?
body: I'm trying to set up SAML 2.0 with Azure AD as the Identity Provider. The initial handshake seems to work, but I'm getting an 'Invalid SAML Response' error on the Liferay side. Any tips?

author: dan.novak
title: Custom Object fields not appearing in search
body: I created a custom object 'Project' with a 'description' field. I marked it as searchable, but it doesn't show up in the search results widget. I tried re-indexing everything but no luck.

author: elena.petrov
title: Should I use Service Builder or Objects for new projects?
body: We're starting a new project and I'm torn between using the classic Service Builder or the new Objects feature. What's the current recommendation for a simple CRUD application?

author: frank.tanaka
title: Memory leak in Document Library during large uploads
body: We're seeing a steady increase in heap usage when users upload multiple large files (500MB+) to the Document Library. The JVM eventually crashes with an OutOfMemoryError.

author: grace.obi
title: Native Dark Mode support for the Control Panel
body: The Liferay admin interface is great, but a native dark mode would be amazing for those of us working late nights. Is this on the roadmap?

author: lilly.zhao
title: Fragment Editor bug in Safari
body: I'm experiencing weird layout issues in the Fragment Editor when using Safari. The preview pane seems to overlap with the code editor. Anyone else seeing this?

author: alice.morgan
title: Optimizing Liferay for High Traffic Sites
body: We're expecting a massive traffic spike next month. What are the most important configurations to tune in Liferay to handle high concurrency?

author: bob.chen
title: Client Extension not loading in production
body: My React-based Client Extension works fine on my local machine, but it fails to load in our production environment. The console says 'failed to fetch dynamically imported module'.

author: dan.novak
title: Testing the new AI Search features in 2025.Q4
body: Has anyone tried the new AI Search features in 2025.Q4 yet? I'm curious about the accuracy of the vector embeddings and the infrastructure requirements.
